data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (31 Dec 2017) is recorded at c. GBP 388.4m (balance sheet). The report discusses material 2018 catastrophe activity (Typhoon Jebi, Hurricanes Florence and Michael, California wildfires) and an improvement in the syndicate's loss ratio versus 2017. A definitive GROSS prioryear movement figure (movement in prior years' provision) is not explicitly located in the notes available for extraction; therefore no quantified prioryear development is reported here. Primary drivers referenced are 2018 natural catastrophe losses, favourable claims development in older years and reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: The improvement in loss ratio by (15.3%)
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding extracted from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities: Claims outstanding) using the 2017 comparative column (page 14). Prior-year development (gross) could not be unambiguously located in the available images: the report contains narrative about net movements and catastrophe losses but I could not find a clear 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. A gross claims development triangle appears in the notes (pages ~38-39) but was not fully parsed to compute PYD (time/quality constraints and some table cells not legible). Premium total taken from Income statement (page 10). Segmental premium breakdown (regulatory class names and amounts) was not clearly legible in the images provided, so gross_premium_mix is empty. Where numeric values are given confidence is moderate (0.8-0.9) for the balance sheet and premium total; all other quantitative fields are null or low confidence.
